metaTitle: How to Size a Hiking Backpack
description: Measure your torso from C7 to your hip bones, read pack size charts and check hip belt, shoulder strap and load lifter fit with a loaded pack.
directAnswer: Size a pack by torso length, measured from the base of the neck to the line across your hip bones. The hip belt should sit on your hip bones, with load lifters angling up and back at about 45 degrees.
